caption: The image depicts a round ceramic plate with a detailed black-and-white illustration at its center and a decorative border. The central illustration features a large neoclassical building with a dome and columns, positioned in the background. Surrounding the building are several smaller structures and trees. In the foreground, there are two cows and a sheep lying on the ground under a tree, with grass and a small pond or water element nearby. A few human figures are seen, some walking and others possibly tending to the animals. The border of the plate is decorated with an intricate floral pattern consisting of large flowers and leaves, rendered in a consistent monochrome tone that matches the central illustration. The entire plate is done in shades of gray, indicating it is likely a black-and-white photograph of a plate with a transfer-printed or painted design.
title: Plate - "Boston State House"
